topic: DIY home haircuts vs paying the salon every month (Ledger vs Thora)

scenes.narration: Regular salon cuts can quietly cost over four hundred dollars a year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding hair clippers and a salon receipt, comic burst banner reads FOUR HUNDRED A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ledger and Thora both get a haircut every four weeks.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man ledger and woman thora in gym gear beside a calendar labeled EVERY FOUR WEEKS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each cut plus tip costs them about thirty five dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ledger and thora holding salon receipts on a gym bench stamped THIRTY FIVE DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ledger keeps booking the same salon chair month after month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ledger tapping a booking app on a gym mat, a banner reads SALON AGAIN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never once considers that a simple trim is easily learnable.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ledger shrugging by a gym locker beside unused clippers stamped WHY BOTHER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thora buys a thirty dollar clipper kit online just once.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thora unboxing a clipper kit on a gym bench, a price tag stamped THIRTY DOLLARS ONCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She watches tutorials and trims her own hair at home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thora trimming her hair before a mirror in the gym, a phone screen labeled TUTORIAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: After two practice tries her home cuts look totally clean.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thora admiring a fresh clean haircut in a gym mirror, a banner reads CLEAN CUT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Ledger spent over four hundred at salons.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked ledger on a gym bench holding a stack of salon receipts stamped FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thora spent thirty dollars once and basically nothing after that.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thora holding one small receipt in the gym stamped THIRTY DOLLARS TOTAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She banked nearly four hundred dollars in effortless yearly savings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thora dropping cash into a gym jar labeled SAVINGS, a tag reading NEARLY FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Learn a simple home trim and skip the pricey salon. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
